selection.method: Shortest retained observed-peak-to-lifecycle-end interval among candidates with a qualified opening market cap, retained observed peak, and severe retained post-peak drawdown. Provider response was not used for selection.

limitations: The empty returned candle collection establishes no qualifying retained provider observation in this one bounded request; it does not establish that no crash occurred.
The retained aggregate post-peak drawdown was not treated as a single-candle crash.
